thread:
claire: Quick lunchtime logistics: can someone pick up oat milk and the gluten-free crackers? coffee station is almost out of medium roast.
dan: I can stop by during my walk. any preference for oat milk brand?
maya: Oatly if possible, otherwise barista-style Oat. and yes to crackers. also microwave lid went missing again.
frank: I think I borrowed the lid for my Tupperware yesterday, leaving it marked. will return it at 1.
sophie: Also small PSA  please empty the drip tray on the espresso machine on Fridays or it overflows. I cleaned it this morning but it filled quickly.
kitchen-bot: Inventory alert: medium roast 0.5 bags remaining, oat milk 1 carton, gluten-free crackers 0 boxes. Suggested action: restock within 72h. react :bell:
claire: Thanks @kitchen-bot. Dan if you could grab Oatly and crackers that'd be amazing. I'll reimburse.
dan: On it. Also leaving a sticky note template by the sink: "Tupperware lid borrowed by: name/date" so we stop the lid mystery.
maya: Love the template idea. tiny request: label the jar of ground coffee with grinder settings? newbies keep changing it and espresso is sad.
frank: Good point. I'll put a small label: "Espresso grind only" on the top.
sophie: Also can we agree on a "no reheated seafood" policy? my plants still mourn last week's tuna incident.
claire: Agreed. Added to the fridge rules doc. Anyone want to be presented with an emergency donut when policies are broken?
dan: Donut accountability is strong. I'll be back in 25 with supplies.
kitchen-bot: Action logged: restock request for medium roast and oat milk submitted. react :white_check_mark:
maya: Thank you all. tiny reminder  if you use shared plates/utensils, please rinse immediately. Makes the afternoon kumbaya.
frank: Lid returned to the labeled hook. Crisis averted. :relieved:
sophie: Heading back to the meeting room. If anyone wants a coffee, I'm bringing one to the 2pm sync.
claire: Coffee and crackers salvation. See you all at the sink. :coffee:
